definitions.explanation: A person who does electrical wiring and installation work. Also used as an abbreviation for electrical construction work or as part of company names in the electrical industry.

examples.japanese: {電工|でんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
{電工|でんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to get an electrician's license.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{電工|でんこう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧きた。
examples.english: My father has worked as an electrician for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンセント→コンセント：04431_konsento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{増設|ぞうせつ}→増設：18851_zousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電工|でんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should have an electrician handle adding electrical outlets.

notes:
An abbreviation of ⟦{電気|でんき}{工事|こうじ}{士|し}→電気工事士：30200_denkikoujishi⟧ (electrical construction worker) or ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{工|こう} (electrical worker). The word serves double duty: it refers to the person (electrician) and, as an abbreviation, to the trade or field of electrical work itself.

The formal license is called ⟦{電気|でんき}{工事|こうじ}{士|し}→電気工事士：30200_denkikoujishi⟧, with two levels: {第二種|だいにしゅ} (for residential/small-scale work) and {第一種|だいいっしゅ} (for large-scale industrial/commercial work). In everyday speech, {電工|でんこう} is the common shorthand for both the license and the profession.

The word also appears in major company names like {松下|まつした}{電工|でんこう} (Matsushita Electric Works, now Panasonic).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電工|でんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: electrician's license
- {電工|でんこう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: electrical construction work
- {電工|でんこう}⟦ドラム→ドラム：04463_doramu⟧: extension cord reel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}{工事|こうじ}{士|し}→電気工事士：30200_denkikoujishi⟧: licensed electrician — the formal, full term for the profession
- ⟦{電気|でんき}{技師|ぎし}→電気技師：07091_denkigishi⟧: electrical engineer — a higher-level technical role focused on design and systems
- ⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧{工|こう}: wiring worker — more specific to the wiring aspect of electrical work
